```{r}
library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)


# ============================================================
# 1. PATH
# ============================================================

root_dir <- "C:/projects/clinreport/raw/clinreport"

sources <- c(
  "chembl",
  "opentargets",
  "pubchem"
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Безопасное преобразование любого значения в строку
# ============================================================

collapse_value <- function(x) {

  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # atomic
  if (is.atomic(x)) {

    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }

    return(
      paste(unique(x), collapse = "; ")
    )
  }

  # всё остальное
  flat <- flatten_json(x)

  if (length(flat) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  values <- unlist(
    flat,
    use.names = FALSE
  )

  values <- values[
    !is.na(values) &
      values != ""
  ]

  if (length(values) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(
    unique(values),
    collapse = "; "
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 3. Универсальный flatten JSON
# ============================================================

flatten_json <- function(x, prefix = "") {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # NULL / пустое
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) {
    return(list())
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # atomic value
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.atomic(x)) {

    if (prefix == "") {
      return(list())
    }

    value <- collapse_atomic(x)

    return(
      setNames(
        list(value),
        prefix
      )
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # data.frame
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.data.frame(x)) {

    if (nrow(x) == 0 || ncol(x) == 0) {
      return(list())
    }

    result <- list()

    for (nm in names(x)) {

      column <- x[[nm]]

      column_prefix <- if (prefix == "") {
        nm
      } else {
        paste(prefix, nm, sep = "_")
      }


      # list-column
      if (is.list(column)) {

        values <- map_chr(
          column,
          function(v) {

            if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0) {
              return(NA_character_)
            }

            if (is.atomic(v)) {
              return(
                collapse_atomic(v)
              )
            }

            flat <- flatten_json(v)

            if (length(flat) == 0) {
              return(NA_character_)
            }

            collapse_atomic(
              unlist(
                flat,
                use.names = FALSE
              )
            )
          }
        )

      } else {

        values <- as.character(column)
      }


      values <- values[
        !is.na(values) &
          values != ""
      ]


      result[[column_prefix]] <- if (
        length(values) == 0
      ) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        paste(
          unique(values),
          collapse = "; "
        )
      }
    }

    return(result)
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # list
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.list(x)) {

    # пустой list
    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(list())
    }

    result <- list()

    nms <- names(x)

    # если имён нет — это массив
    if (is.null(nms)) {

      values <- map(
        x,
        ~ flatten_json(.x)
      )

      values <- values[
        lengths(values) > 0
      ]

      if (length(values) == 0) {
        return(list())
      }

      all_names <- unique(
        unlist(
          map(values, names)
        )
      )

      for (nm in all_names) {

        vals <- map_chr(
          values,
          function(v) {

            if (is.null(v[[nm]])) {
              return(NA_character_)
            }

            as.character(
              v[[nm]]
            )
          }
        )

        vals <- vals[
          !is.na(vals) &
            vals != ""
        ]

        if (length(vals) > 0) {

          result[[nm]] <- paste(
            unique(vals),
            collapse = "; "
          )
        }
      }

      return(result)
    }


    # обычный named list
    for (nm in nms) {

      if (
        is.null(nm) ||
        is.na(nm) ||
        nm == ""
      ) {
        next
      }

      child <- x[[nm]]

      new_prefix <- if (prefix == "") {
        nm
      } else {
        paste(
          prefix,
          nm,
          sep = "_"
        )
      }


      # NULL / пустое
      if (
        is.null(child) ||
        length(child) == 0
      ) {
        next
      }


      # atomic
      if (is.atomic(child)) {

        result[[new_prefix]] <-
          collapse_atomic(child)

        next
      }


      # data.frame / list
      child_flat <- flatten_json(
        child,
        new_prefix
      )

      if (length(child_flat) > 0) {

        result <- c(
          result,
          child_flat
        )
      }
    }

    return(result)
  }


  list()
}


# ============================================================
# 4. Atomic -> character
# ============================================================

collapse_atomic <- function(x) {

  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  x <- as.character(x)

  x <- x[
    !is.na(x)
  ]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(
    unique(x),
    collapse = "; "
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 5. Извлекаем DB ID из имени папки
#
# all_samples...._DB00246
#              -> DB00246
# ============================================================

extract_db_id <- function(folder_name) {

  id <- str_extract(
    folder_name,
    "DB[0-9]+$"
  )

  if (is.na(id)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  id
}


# ============================================================
# 6. Читаем один JSON безопасно
# ============================================================

read_json_safe <- function(file) {

  tryCatch(

    fromJSON(
      file,
      simplifyVector = TRUE
    ),

    error = function(e) {

      warning(
        "Cannot read JSON: ",
        basename(file),
        "\n",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )

      NULL
    }
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 7. Читаем одну папку DB
# ============================================================

read_db_folder <- function(
    db_dir,
    source,
    db_id
) {

  json_files <- list.files(
    db_dir,
    pattern = "\\.json$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  # Нет JSON
  if (length(json_files) == 0) {

    return(
      list(
        drug_id = db_id
      )
    )
  }


  result <- list(
    drug_id = db_id
  )


  for (file in json_files) {

    json_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
      basename(file)
    )

    json <- read_json_safe(file)


    # JSON не прочитался
    if (is.null(json)) {
      next
    }


    # flatten
    flat <- tryCatch(

      flatten_json(
        json,
        prefix = json_name
      ),

      error = function(e) {

        warning(
          "Cannot flatten: ",
          basename(file),
          "\n",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )

        list()
      }
    )


    # Пустой JSON — просто пропускаем
    if (length(flat) == 0) {
      next
    }


    # ВАЖНО:
    # здесь уже проверяем length,
    # поэтому ошибки names(flat) не будет

    flat_names <- names(flat)

    if (
      is.null(flat_names) ||
      length(flat_names) == 0
    ) {
      next
    }


    # Добавляем источник
    names(flat) <- paste(
      source,
      flat_names,
      sep = "_"
    )


    # Добавляем поля
    result <- c(
      result,
      flat
    )
  }


  result
}


# ============================================================
# 8. Читаем ВСЕ источники
# ============================================================

all_drugs <- list()


for (source in sources) {

  source_dir <- file.path(
    root_dir,
    source
  )


  if (!dir.exists(source_dir)) {

    warning(
      "Source directory does not exist: ",
      source_dir
    )

    next
  }


  # Только непосредственные папки внутри source
  db_folders <- list.dirs(
    source_dir,
    recursive = FALSE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )


  for (db_dir in db_folders) {

    folder_name <- basename(db_dir)

    db_id <- extract_db_id(
      folder_name
    )


    # Не удалось найти DBxxxxx
    if (is.null(db_id)) {

      warning(
        "DB ID not found in folder: ",
        folder_name
      )

      next
    }


    message(
      sprintf(
        "[%s] %s",
        source,
        db_id
      )
    )


    flat <- read_db_folder(
      db_dir = db_dir,
      source = source,
      db_id = db_id
    )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Если препарат встречается впервые
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (is.null(all_drugs[[db_id]])) {

      all_drugs[[db_id]] <- flat

    } else {

      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Уже есть из другого источника
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      existing_names <- names(
        all_drugs[[db_id]]
      )

      new_names <- names(flat)


      # Не добавляем повторно drug_id
      new_names <- setdiff(
        new_names,
        existing_names
      )


      if (length(new_names) > 0) {

        all_drugs[[db_id]] <- c(
          all_drugs[[db_id]],
          flat[new_names]
        )
      }
    }
  }
}


# ============================================================
# 9. Собираем полный список колонок
# ============================================================

all_columns <- unique(
  unlist(
    map(
      all_drugs,
      names
    )
  )
)


# drug_id первым
all_columns <- c(
  "drug_id",
  setdiff(
    all_columns,
    "drug_id"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 10. Один плоский dataframe
# ============================================================

drug_df <- map_dfr(
  all_drugs,
  function(x) {

    # Добавляем отсутствующие колонки
    missing_columns <- setdiff(
      all_columns,
      names(x)
    )

    if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {

      x[missing_columns] <-
        NA_character_
    }


    # Правильный порядок
    x <- x[
      all_columns
    ]


    as_tibble(x)
  }
)


# ============================================================
# 11. Удаляем полностью пустые колонки
# ============================================================

drug_df <- drug_df |>
  select(
    where(
      ~ !all(
        is.na(.x) |
          .x == ""
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# ПОДГОТОВКА ДАННЫХ ДЛЯ ИНТЕРФЕЙСА
# ============================================================

drug_table <- drug_df |>
  select(
    drug_id,
    chembl_chembl_id_drug_name,
    chembl_chembl_id_chembl_id,
    chembl_chembl_molecule_pref_name,
    chembl_chembl_molecule_max_phase,
    pubchem_pubchem_cids_IdentifierList_CID,
    opentargets_opentargets_id_drug_name
  ) |>
  mutate(
    drug_name = coalesce(
      na_if(
        chembl_chembl_id_drug_name,
        ""
      ),
      na_if(
        chembl_chembl_molecule_pref_name,
        ""
      ),
      na_if(
        opentargets_opentargets_id_drug_name,
        ""
      ),
      drug_id
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    drug_id,
    drug_name,
    everything()
  )
```

```{r}
pretty_name <- function(x) {

  x |>
    str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
    str_replace_all(
      "(?i)chembl",
      "ChEMBL"
    ) |>
    str_replace_all(
      "(?i)pubchem",
      "PubChem"
    ) |>
    str_replace_all(
      "(?i)opentargets",
      "Open Targets"
    ) |>
    str_replace_all(
      "(?i)cid",
      "CID"
    ) |>
    str_replace_all(
      "(?i)inchi",
      "InChI"
    ) |>
    str_replace_all(
      "(?i)smiles",
      "SMILES"
    ) |>
    str_to_sentence()
}
```

```{r}
render_fields <- function(
    data,
    columns,
    exclude_empty = TRUE
) {

  columns <- intersect(
    columns,
    names(data)
  )

  if (length(columns) == 0) {
    return(
      div(
        class = "empty-message",
        "No data available"
      )
    )
  }

  rows <- map(
    columns,
    function(col) {

      value <- data[[col]][1]

      # Защита от NULL / NA / пустого
      if (
        is.null(value) ||
        length(value) == 0 ||
        is.na(value) ||
        identical(as.character(value), "")
      ) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      value <- as.character(value)

      value <- htmltools::htmlEscape(
        value
      )

      value <- str_replace_all(
        value,
        "; ",
        "<br>"
      )

      div(
        class = "field-row",

        div(
          class = "field-name",
          pretty_name(col)
        ),

        div(
          class = "field-value",
          HTML(value)
        )
      )
    }
  )

  rows <- rows[
    !map_lgl(
      rows,
      is.null
    )
  ]

  if (length(rows) == 0) {
    return(
      div(
        class = "empty-message",
        "No data available"
      )
    )
  }

  tagList(rows)
}
```

```{r}
server <- function(
    input,
    output,
    session
) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Основная таблица
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  output$drug_table <- renderDT({

    datatable(

      drug_table |>
        select(
          drug_id,
          drug_name,
          chembl_chembl_id_chembl_id,
          pubchem_pubchem_cids_IdentifierList_CID
        ),

      selection = "single",

      rownames = FALSE,

      filter = "top",

      options = list(
        pageLength = 15,
        scrollX = TRUE,
        autoWidth = TRUE
      ),

      colnames = c(
        "Drug ID",
        "Drug name",
        "ChEMBL ID",
        "PubChem CID"
      )
    )
  })


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Выбранный препарат
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  selected_drug <- reactive({

    req(
      input$drug_table_rows_selected
    )

    drug_table[
      input$drug_table_rows_selected,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  })


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Детальная карточка
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  output$drug_details <- renderUI({

    req(
      selected_drug()
    )

    drug <- selected_drug()

    drug_id <- drug$drug_id


    # Находим полную строку
    full_drug <- drug_df |>
      filter(
        drug_id == !!drug_id
      ) |>
      slice(1)


    drug_name <- coalesce(
      full_drug$chembl_chembl_id_drug_name,
      full_drug$chembl_chembl_molecule_pref_name,
      full_drug$opentargets_opentargets_id_drug_name,
      drug_id
    )


    tagList(

      div(
        class = "drug-card",

        div(
          class = "drug-title",
          drug_name
        ),

        div(
          class = "drug-subtitle",
          drug_id
        ),


        tabsetPanel(

          # ==================================================
          # TAB 1
          # ==================================================

          tabPanel(

            "Основная информация",

            div(
              class = "section-title",
              "Identifiers"
            ),

            render_fields(
              full_drug,

              c(
                "chembl_chembl_id_drug_id",
                "chembl_chembl_id_drug_name",
                "chembl_chembl_id_chembl_id",
                "pubchem_pubchem_cids_IdentifierList_CID",
                "pubchem_pubchem_properties_PropertyTable_Properties_CID",
                "opentargets_opentargets_id_drug_id",
                "opentargets_opentargets_id_opentargets_id"
              )
            ),


            div(
              class = "section-title",
              "Molecular properties"
            ),

            render_fields(
              full_drug,

              c(
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_type",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_properties_full_molformula",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_properties_full_mwt",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_properties_mw_freebase",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_properties_alogp",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_properties_hba",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_properties_hbd",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_properties_psa",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_properties_rtb",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_properties_aromatic_rings"
              )
            ),


            div(
              class = "section-title",
              "Structures"
            ),

            render_fields(
              full_drug,

              c(
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_structures_canonical_smiles",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_structures_standard_inchi",
                "chembl_chembl_molecule_molecule_structures_standard_inchi_key",
                "pubchem_pubchem_properties_PropertyTable_Properties_SMILES",
                "pubchem_pubchem_properties_PropertyTable_Properties_ConnectivitySMILES",
                "pubchem_pubchem_properties_PropertyTable_Properties_InChI",
                "pubchem_pubchem_properties_PropertyTable_Properties_InChIKey"
              )
            )
          ),


          # ==================================================
          # TAB 2
          # ==================================================

          tabPanel(

            "Показания и механизм",

            div(
              class = "section-title",
              "Indications"
            ),

            render_fields(
              full_drug,

              grep(
                "indications",
                names(full_drug),
                value = TRUE
              )
            ),


            div(
              class = "section-title",
              "Mechanisms"
            ),

            render_fields(
              full_drug,

              grep(
                "mechanisms",
                names(full_drug),
                value = TRUE
              )
            ),


            div(
              class = "section-title",
              "Open Targets"
            ),

            render_fields(
              full_drug,

              grep(
                "opentargets",
                names(full_drug),
                value = TRUE
              )
            )
          ),


          # ==================================================
          # TAB 3
          # ==================================================

          tabPanel(

            "Предупреждения и источники",

            div(
              class = "section-title",
              "Warnings"
            ),

            render_fields(
              full_drug,

              grep(
                "warnings",
                names(full_drug),
                value = TRUE
              )
            ),


            div(
              class = "section-title",
              "PubChem"
            ),

            render_fields(
              full_drug,

              grep(
                "^pubchem_",
                names(full_drug),
                value = TRUE
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  })
}
```
